sources.observed_relation: ## Goal Make repeated Venus self-improvement statistically valid when many candidate successors are proposed and evaluated adaptively. ## Why this is a separate burden A frozen benchmark can become part of the developmental loop. Repeatedly asking "did this candidate score higher?" on the same validation surface creates adaptive multiple testing and can select false improvements even when each individual evaluation looks reasonable.
